meta.canonical: design/tokens.json in the heinzel repository; this file is its mirror. Version 2: the paper and deep green palette is the default for the app and the Pages site (owner decision, 31 Oct 2026).

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Page ground, in the app and on the Pages site: warm paper, deep green at night.

tokens.name: color-foreground
tokens.usage: Body text, deep green ink, on color-background, color-card, color-popover, color-sidebar, color-muted and color-input. 11.6:1 light, 13.6:1 dark on color-background.

tokens.name: color-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces: command boxes, detail panes, tinted bands on the Pages site.

tokens.name: color-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text on color-background, color-card, color-popover, color-sidebar and color-muted. 5.6:1 light, 7.9:1 dark on color-background; 4.8:1 on color-muted light.

tokens.name: color-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. The Card component paints it at 40% over the ground.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between areas, in the app and on the Pages site. Decorative: it does not carry meaning, so controls that need an edge also have a label or fill.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: The one rust accent: the primary action, links, the current selection, in the app and on the Pages site. Use it once per view where you can. As text it holds 4.5:1 on every surface here: 5.8:1 light and 9.4:1 dark on color-background, 5.1:1 light on color-muted.

tokens.name: color-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-primary. 6.1:1 light, 9.4:1 dark. Dark mode text is dark on purpose: white on the pale rust would be 1.5:1.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill, the off state of a switch, the person's chat bubble. Text on it is color-accent-foreground; status colours do not read on it.

tokens.name: color-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-accent, the active navigation item. 10.2:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-ok
tokens.usage: Status text and marks: up, done. Always with a word and a mark. On color-background and color-card: 5.3:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: Status text and marks: degraded, needs attention. Always with a word and a mark. On color-background and color-card: 5.1:1 light, 9.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-bad
tokens.usage: Status text and marks: down, failed. Always with a word and a mark. On color-background and color-card only: 5.3:1 light, 6.1:1 dark; on dark color-popover, color-input and color-muted it is 4.3:1, so there the word carries it.

tokens.name: color-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset. 5.8:1 light, 9.4:1 dark on color-background.

tokens.name: color-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground: one step of paper darker than the page. Chosen for the paper palette, not taken from the Pages site, which has no sidebar.

tokens.name: color-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: color-input
tokens.usage: Input and search field ground.

tokens.name: color-icon
tokens.usage: Icons that are not active, on every surface above. 6.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark on color-background.

tokens.name: color-switch
tokens.usage: A switch that is on, white knob in both modes. The only blue in the chrome, and themes cannot change it.

tokens.name: color-main-tint
tokens.usage: A theme's soft tint at the top of the main area. Transparent by default (`transparent` in the source).

tokens.name: hat-red
tokens.usage: Hat colour red. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.name: hat-rust
tokens.usage: Hat colour rust. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.usage: Hat colour ochre. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.usage: Hat colour teal. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.usage: Shirt colour green. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.name: shirt-blue
tokens.usage: Shirt colour blue. Drawing only, at least 3:1 on light and dark; never text.

tokens.name: shirt-purple

tokens.name: heinzel-face
tokens.usage: Face and hands. Drawing only.

tokens.name: heinzel-ink
tokens.usage: Eyes, mouth and outlines. Drawing only.

tokens.name: heinzel-trousers
tokens.usage: Trousers. Drawing only.

tokens.name: heinzel-boots
tokens.usage: Boots. Drawing only.

tokens.name: state-sleeping
tokens.usage: The sleeping badge behind a white mark on the avatar. Working and idle have no badge. Never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: state-thinking
tokens.usage: The thinking badge behind a white mark on the avatar. Working and idle have no badge. Never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: The waiting badge behind a white mark on the avatar. Working and idle have no badge. Never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: The blocked badge behind a white mark on the avatar. Working and idle have no badge. Never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: The done badge behind a white mark on the avatar. Working and idle have no badge. Never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: badge-green
tokens.usage: Static README badges whose statement is always true (License). White on it is 2.5:1: badge fills only, never text. Status badges (CI, coverage, Scorecard, Sonar) keep their provider's colour so a red stays red.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Navigation, dialog titles, the app's name (--text-ui). A theme may change it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 80 words, 5 sources. Fix what you like, then approve.
styles.usage: Running text and buttons: the body default, text-sm.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Secondary interface text (--text-ui-sm). A theme may change it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, card titles, small buttons, text-xs.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: A graph node's sublabel. Dense graph surfaces only.

styles.name: nano
styles.usage: A graph node's badge. Graph surfaces only.

styles.name: heading-3xl
styles.usage: The largest size in the app. Rare.

styles.name: heading-2xl
styles.usage: Onboarding and full-page moments.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Error and empty screen headlines.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Sections inside a dialog or page.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands in CopyCommand, identifiers, error detail.

styles.name: pages-hero
styles.usage: The home hero only: clamp(40px, 4.8vw, 56px). Same family and weight as the app, larger because it is read at arm's length.

styles.name: pages-h1
styles.usage: Page titles on the Pages site (2rem at the site's 20px root).

styles.name: pages-h2
styles.usage: Section headings on the Pages site (1.4rem).

styles.name: pages-h3
styles.usage: Subsections on the Pages site (1rem).

styles.name: pages-lead
styles.sample: Each helper keeps one promise and asks before anything leaves your machine.
styles.usage: The hero lead (1rem), at most 43rem wide.

styles.name: pages-body
styles.usage: Running text on the Pages site (0.8rem at the 20px root).

styles.name: pages-button
styles.usage: Site buttons: min-height 44px, radius-lg, color-primary with color-primary-foreground; quiet variant color-foreground on a color-border edge.

styles.name: pages-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a hero or section; color-muted-foreground.

styles.name: pages-caption
styles.usage: Captions and the trust row; color-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: The base step every gap and padding multiplies (Tailwind's --spacing). A theme may change it.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Navigation and dialog icon size (`size-(--icon)`). A theme may change it.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Navigation and list row height (`h-(--row)`). A theme may change it.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: App page width (max-w-4xl) and the Pages site reading column.

tokens.name: home-max
tokens.usage: The Pages home grid. The one width wider than page-max.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on the Pages site and every overlay control. App rows are row (36px) because the app is dense; axe asserts at least 24px.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: A quarter of radius-lg in the source, so it follows a theme.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Half of radius-lg; `rounded`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Half of radius-lg; `rounded-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Three quarters of radius-lg: command boxes, compact error blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, navigation items (theme field radius_control).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, graph nodes (theme field radius).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Four thirds of radius-xl. Not used on the Pages site.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Twice radius-xl.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: Badge and Switch. The only corner a theme does not change.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Graph nodes at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Graph nodes on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs. Everything else stays flat and is set apart by a hairline.

layer.note: One stacking order across body-portaled media and app overlays.

tokens.name: layer-media
tokens.usage: Docked and floating players.

tokens.name: layer-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: layer-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.
